title: Do We Really Need Quantum Machine Learning?: A Multidimensional Empirical Study
summary: The rapid growth of computer vision and increasingly complex image recognition tasks has exposed fundamental computational limitations of classical machine learning models, motivating the exploration of quantum computing as an emerging new paradigm.
